hazards: GHS05 Corrosive. Causes catastrophic irreversible chemical burns to cornea and dermis. Exothermic heat of solution can cause vigorous boiling.
handling: Dissolve pellets slowly with continuous mechanical stirring. Do not touch pellets barehanded. Wear nitrile gloves and face shield.

first_aid.eye_contact: Emergency ocular irrigation for minimum 20 minutes. Continuous ophthalmology consult.
first_aid.ingestion: Do NOT induce vomiting. Rinse mouth with water and contact poison control immediately.

storage: Store in tightly sealed airtight HDPE container inside designated inorganic base cabinet. Keep away from strong acids and aluminum.
